promiseTitle: Har Ghar Jal - 100% Rural Tap Water Connections
description: Provide functional household tap connection (FHTC) to all 19.3 Crore rural households by 2024 under Jal Jeevan Mission.
evidenceSummary: PIB & Jal Jeevan Mission Portal (Aug 2024): 15.1 Crore (78.2%) rural households achieved, up from 3.2 Crore (17%) in 2019.

promiseTitle: Housing for All - PM Awas Yojana
description: Construction of 4 Crore pucca houses for rural and urban poor families with LPG, electricity, and sanitation facilities.
evidenceSummary: Ministry of Rural Development & MoHUA Disclosures (Jan 2024): 3.52 Crore rural and 1.18 Crore urban houses sanctioned & completed.

description: Provide ₹6,000 per year in 3 equal installments directly to all landholding farmer families nationwide.
evidenceSummary: Union Budget 2024 Statement 2: ₹3.24 Lakh Crore transferred directly to 11+ Crore farmers via Aadhaar-seeded bank accounts with zero leakage.

description: Accelerate highway construction to 40 km/day and build 35,000 km under Bharatmala Pariyojana phase 1.
evidenceSummary: MoRTH Annual Performance Report (2024): Peak highway construction reached 37 km/day in FY21 and 34 km/day in FY24. 55,000+ km built since 2014.

promiseTitle: Ayushman Bharat - World's Largest Health Cover
description: Provide ₹5 Lakh per family per year secondary & tertiary hospitalization coverage to 50 Crore vulnerable citizens.
evidenceSummary: National Health Authority Dashboard (2024): 34.5 Crore Ayushman Cards issued; over 6.5 Crore hospital admissions authorized worth ₹82,000 Cr.

description: Implement One Rank One Pension for defense personnel to equalize pensions for same rank & length of service regardless of retirement date.
evidenceSummary: Ministry of Defence Audit Report (2023): OROP implementation & Revision 2 arrears disbursed to 25.13 Lakh veterans (₹28,138 Cr total).

description: Manufacture and deploy 75 indigenous Vande Bharat Express trainsets to modernize passenger rail network.
evidenceSummary: Railway Board Official Release (May 2024): 102 Vande Bharat train services active connecting 280+ districts nationwide.

description: Develop 100 sustainable smart cities equipped with Integrated Command and Control Centers (ICCC) and modern civic infrastructure.
evidenceSummary: Smart Cities Mission Portal (June 2024): 7,150 of 8,000 planned projects completed (89.3% project completion rate).

description: Provide last-mile electricity connections to all willing un-electrified households in rural and urban areas.
evidenceSummary: REC / Ministry of Power Release (2021): 2.86 Crore households electrified; 100% village electrification achieved.

description: Conduct transparent 5G spectrum auction and deploy 5G mobile network across all major Indian cities within 12 months.
evidenceSummary: Department of Telecommunications (2024): 4.42 Lakh 5G BTS towers installed covering 738 districts, recognized as world's fastest 5G rollout.

description: Achieve 500 GW renewable energy capacity and 50% non-fossil fuel share in total power generation capacity.
evidenceSummary: MNRE Monthly Status Report (June 2024): Non-fossil installed capacity reached 203.7 GW (45.3% of total installed grid capacity).

promiseTitle: PM Ujjwala Yojana - Clean Cooking Fuel
description: Provide deposit-free LPG connections to 10 Crore poor women to eliminate indoor air pollution.
evidenceSummary: MoPNG Disclosure (2024): 10.33 Crore Ujjwala connections delivered; LPG coverage increased from 62% (2016) to 99.8% (2024).

description: Double real income of Indian farmers through MSP hikes, PM Fasal Bima Yojana, and agricultural market reforms.
evidenceSummary: NITI Aayog / ICAR Evaluation (2023): Real farm income increased 28-35% vs 100% target; affected by global fertilizer spikes and climate events.
